meta.name: webhook-management
meta.description: Configure and validate CCAM webhook targets across supported chat, incident, automation, and generic providers. Use when listing provider requirements, creating or updating a target, scoping it to alert rules, sending a test notification, reviewing delivery history, or deleting a target.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 配置并验证各平台 Webhook 推送目标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要统一管理多平台的 Webhook 推送配置。
copy.tagline_en: Manage and validate webhook targets across providers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to centrally manage webhook endpoints for multiple providers.

howto.what: 这个技能会帮你管理 CCAM 的 webhook 目标:列出供应商和已有目标,用本地 JSON 文件创建或更新(需你确认),发送测试通知前再次确认,并查看投递记录。敏感字段不会出现在对话中。
howto.when: 当你想列出供应商要求、创建/更新目标,或发送测试通知等时。

say.text: 列出可用的 webhook 供应商要求
say.note: 会查询供应商列表并展示要求

say.text: 创建一个新的 webhook 目标,关联到告警规则
say.note: 会先确认,并说明是否发送真实测试消息

say.text: 给这个 webhook 目标发送测试通知
say.note: 会再次确认,因为会向外部发送消息

howto.what_en: Manages CCAM webhook targets: queries provider requirements, inspects saved targets, creates/updates via local JSON files after confirmation, sends test messages only after explicit consent, and reviews delivery records. Secrets never printed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to configure webhook targets (e.g., create/update, send test, view history, delete).

say_en.note: Queries providers and shows their requirements

say_en.text: Create a new webhook target and scope it to alert rules
say_en.note: Confirms first; says if a real test is sent

say_en.text: Send a test notification to this webhook target
say_en.note: Confirms again because it sends an external message
